1976-3693-4659-5224.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {1} due to Etherium Sculptor, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Walking Ballista, adding {C}{C}.
When Walking Ballista dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Walking Ballista from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1395-4478-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1339-2511-2835.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2511-2835.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-4474-6248--52.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-6248--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

323-1957-4050--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target player to lose 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

620-1429-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Repeat.

280-3177-7857.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.

2919-3197-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

2034-4013-5359.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Threefold Thunderhulk.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1232-1270-4478-5477.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

3062-7009-7334.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3062-7009-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
3062-7009-7334.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, triggering its ability, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Pir
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

2292-2692-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1483-2511-6972--112.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
1483-2511-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

147-554-997.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-554-997.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2279-5497-6718.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Extractor Demon triggers, causing you to mill two cards if your graveyard is empty, or causing an opponent to mill two cards otherwise.
If your library is empty, activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting a card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating a 3/2 Spirit creature token.
Repeat.
2034-2279-5497-6718.notes: The combo will grant you an amount of {C} equal to the number of cards in your library, as you do not need to do step 3 as long as your library has cards in it. You can instead also target an opponent in step 2 if your graveyard is not empty.

2034-4871-6214.description:
Cast Glitch Interpreter by paying {2}{U}.
When Glitch Interpreter enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to return it from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to manifest dread.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the manifested card, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

372-813-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-813-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1766-1978-4832.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat.

2104-3662-3942.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {3}{R}{R}{R} each extra turn
2104-3662-3942.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Temporal Manipulation from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Izzet Chemister from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1864-2757-5231.manaNeeded: {3} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1864-2757-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Swamp, Mountain and Forest.
1864-2757-5231.description:
Activate a basic Swamp, Mountain and Forest by tapping them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a number of 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens equal to the amount of mana spent to cast Prossh.
Activate Earthcraft three times by tapping two Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens and Prossh, untapping a basic Swamp, Mountain and Forest.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Kobolds of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 7 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-2792-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}.
2034-2792-5003.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Great Whale, adding {C}{C}.
When Great Whale dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If the lands can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

567-1418-1981-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 50.
567-1418-1981-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating fifty 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers 100 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

1872-2178-4331.notablePrerequisites: Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
1872-2178-4331.description:
Cast Composite Golem by paying {6}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Composite Golem spell.
Resolve the copy of the Composite Golem spell, creating a token copy of Composite Golem.
Activate the token Composite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
The token Composite Golem dies, triggering Drafna, untapping Drafna.
Repeat from step 2.

1694-2719-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Gisela.
Gisela does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents are unable to block flying creatures you control.
You have at least three opponents.
1694-2719-3851.description:
Attack with Gisela.
Gisela's myriad ability triggers, creating a copy of itself for each other opponent that is tapped and attacking that opponent.
Each Gisela deals at least forty-eight combat damage to each opponent.

1414-2882-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
1414-2882-4675-4694.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Lotus Petal enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1518-1987-3277-3573.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.You control at least two artifacts.
1518-1987-3277-3573.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Tolarian Academy and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

2050-3445-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Arbor Elf.
Glittering Frost attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3445-3525.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
